reasons.detail: R1 — `processTemplateFileBatch` now builds a JSON schema mapping directive IDs to strings (`buildBatchJsonSchema`) and passes it via `jsonSchema` in the batch `invokeAgent` call, with required directive keys and `additionalProperties: false`.

R4 — Batch parsing now uses a bounded retry loop (`attempts = retryCount + 1`), retries on invalid JSON mapping, and continues when a later attempt yields valid JSON; only fails after all bounded attempts are exhausted.

R2 — The diff adds `jsonSchemaFlag` and `jsonSchemaMode` to built-in defaults for `claude/sonnet` and `codex/gpt-5.4` (and related providers), and invocation logic now consumes those profile fields when `jsonSchema` is provided.

R3 — The change wires docs.text batch calls to pass `validateResponseForCache`, which validates parsed JSON shape before cache writes in `Agent.call` via `_isCacheableResponse`, so invalid batch JSON responses are rejected from caching.

R5 — The diff adds validation in agent invocation to emit a stderr diagnostic when jsonSchema is requested and the resolved profile is missing jsonSchemaFlag/jsonSchemaMode, including commandId/profile context, and includes a docs.text-specific test asserting both missing field names and commandId appear.

R6 — The diff keeps the successful docs.text generation flow intact while adding JSON schema support: it still fills text directives in the same insertion path, preserves directive-mode selection behavior, allows user provider overrides via existing registry resolution, writes generated markdown through existing text-fill flow, and gates prompt-cache writes with response validation without removing normal cacheability for successful responses.
R7 — The diff introduces no new dependency entries or external-package imports in the modified implementation files, and the `src` changes do not add new project-specific hardcoded values.
